info.name: SYN-443 Barcode Returned-Mail API
info.description:
Returned Mail Barcode Cost Saving Enhancement (SYN-443).

**QC4 (verified 2026-07-28):** `PUT https://api.qc4.acs529.com/...` — body `{"SCAN_RESULT_CODE":"RETURNED"}` — no client cert.

**Stage 1:** `PUT https://api.stage1.acs529.com/...` — body `{"scanResultCode":"RETURNED"}` — **PFX client cert required**. See `docs/07-stage1-postman-cert-setup.md`.

**Postman SSL:** Disable SSL verification if needed (curl uses `-k`).

**KB:** `qa-automation-kb/BarcodeProject/`

item.name: QC4

request.description:
Suresh QC4 curl (verified HTTP 200 on 2026-07-28):

```powershell
$json = '{"SCAN_RESULT_CODE":"RETURNED"}'
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText('C:\temp\returnmail-body.json', $json, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $false))

curl.exe -k -s -w "`nHTTP:%{http_code}" -X PUT `
  "https://api.qc4.acs529.com/api/v1/plans/unite/returnmail/UNT13649678458" `
  -H "Host: api.qc4.acs529.com" `
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" `
  --data-binary "@C:\temp\returnmail-body.json"
```

**Test data (QC4):** `select barcode_id, a.* from tu_sent_mail a;`

item.name: Stage 1

exec: // Stage 1 requires client cert configured in Postman Settings → Certificates

request.description:
Stage 1 curl (requires PFX client cert):

```bash
curl -k -v --connect-timeout 10 -m 30 -X PUT \
  "https://api.stage1.acs529.com/api/v1/plans/unite/returnmail/UNT96080597642" \
  -H "Host: api.stage1.acs529.com" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --cert-type P12 \
  --cert "C:\\...\\kofaxapi.stage.acs529.com.pfx:PASSPHRASE" \
  -d '{"scanResultCode":"RETURNED"}'
```

**Note:** Stage 1 body uses **camelCase** `scanResultCode` (QC4 uses `SCAN_RESULT_CODE`).

**Cert file:** `BarcodeProject/Suresh P12/security/kofaxapi.stage.acs529.com.pfx`

**Setup:** `docs/07-stage1-postman-cert-setup.md`
